def validate_task(env, final_answer: str | None = None) -> int:
    error_accumulator = []
    success_accumulator = []

    env.instance.load()
    seed = env.db("seed")
    current = env.db("current")

    TARGET_EMAIL = "david.nguyen@techcorp.com"
    TARGET_MERCHANT = "Home Depot"
    TARGET_AMOUNT_CENTS = 42886
    TARGET_DATE_PREFIX = "2024-09-27"
    EXPECTED_MEMO = "Home Depot hardware for facilities repair"
    EXPECTED_CATEGORY = "Hardware"
    EXPECTED_GL_CODE = "6900"

    def find_target_transaction(db):
        user = db.table("users").eq("email", TARGET_EMAIL).first()
        if not user:
            return None, None

        txns = db.table("transactions").eq("user_id", user["id"]).all()
        matches = [
            txn for txn in txns
            if txn["merchant"] == TARGET_MERCHANT
            and txn["amount_cents"] == TARGET_AMOUNT_CENTS
            and str(txn["transaction_date"]).startswith(TARGET_DATE_PREFIX)
            and txn["status"] == "posted"
        ]
        if len(matches) != 1:
            return user, None
        return user, matches[0]

    seed_user, seed_txn = find_target_transaction(seed)
    current_user, current_txn = find_target_transaction(current)

    if not seed_user:
        error_accumulator.append("[X] Could not find David Nguyen in the seed database")
    else:
        success_accumulator.append("[C] Found David Nguyen in the seed database")

    if not current_user:
        error_accumulator.append("[X] Could not find David Nguyen in the current database")
    else:
        success_accumulator.append("[C] Found David Nguyen in the current database")

        success_accumulator.append("[C] Identified the target Home Depot transaction in the seed database")

        success_accumulator.append("[C] Identified the target Home Depot transaction in the current database")

            print("<<< SUCCESS_ACCUMULATOR <<<")
        return TASK_FAILED_SCORE

    seed_expense = seed.table("expenses").eq("transaction_id", seed_txn["id"]).first()
    current_expense = current.table("expenses").eq("transaction_id", current_txn["id"]).first()

    if not seed_expense:
        error_accumulator.append("[X] Target transaction did not have an associated expense in the seed database")
    else:
        success_accumulator.append("[C] Target transaction had an associated expense in the seed database")

    if not current_expense:
        error_accumulator.append("[X] Target transaction does not have an associated expense in the current database")
    else:
        success_accumulator.append("[C] Target transaction has an associated expense in the current database")

    if error_accumulator:
        print(">>> ERROR_ACCUMULATOR >>>")
        print(error_accumulator)
        print("<<< ERROR_ACCUMULATOR <<<")
        print(">>> SUCCESS_ACCUMULATOR >>>")
        print(success_accumulator)
        print("<<< SUCCESS_ACCUMULATOR <<<")
        return TASK_FAILED_SCORE

    changed_from_seed = (
        current_expense["memo"] != seed_expense["memo"]
        or current_expense["category"] != seed_expense["category"]
        or current_expense["gl_code"] != seed_expense["gl_code"]
    )
    if changed_from_seed:
        success_accumulator.append("[C] Expense fields were changed from the seed state")

        error_accumulator.append("[X] Expense fields were not changed from the seed state")

        error_accumulator.append(

    else:

        )
